caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate object centered on a plain, off-white background. The object is a red, antique firefighter’s helmet featuring intricate golden and green scrollwork and floral decorations on its surface. The helmet has a wide brim and a tall crown, with panels forming the crown structure. On the front panel, there are crossed pikes or axes, and the side panels are adorned with more elaborate patterns and flowers in shades of pink and green. At the top of the helmet, there is a sculptural element in the form of a gold or brass-colored running animal, possibly a lion or panther, standing on a decorative base. The brim also features subtle colored detailing, including hints of blue and additional gold patterns. The drawing is signed “Henry Alexander” in the lower right corner.
title: Fireman's Hat
